And Another Counsel for Applicant :- Ajeet Kumar Yadav,Subhash Chandra Yadav Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Ajai Kumar Srivastava-I,J.
Heard learned counsel for the applicant, learned A.G.A. for the State and perused the record.

The instant application under Section 482 Cr.P.C. filed by the applicant for quashing the impugned order dated 01.04.2023 passed by Sessions Judge, Lucknow in S. T. No.1883 of 2022 "State vs.
Vineet Kumar Yadav", arising out of Case Crime No.188 of 2019, under Sections 376, 494, 498A,
504, 506, 109 I.P.C., Police Station Chowk,District Lucknow by which non bailable warrant has been issued against the applicant.

The only submission of learned counsel for the applicant is that due to certain unavoidable condition, he could not appear to press the application for exemption which led learned trial Court to reject the same and to issue non bailable warrant against the applicant.
He has very fairly submitted that in all eventuality, the applicant shall appear before the learned trial Court on the next date fixed i.e. 29.04.2023 to get the charge framed.
Accordingly, he prays that to enable him to appear before the learned trial Court to get the charge framed, the execution of non bailable warrant requires to be kept in abeyance till then only.

Learned A.G.A. has vehemently opposed the prayer by submitting that the impugned order dated 01.04.2023 came to be passed because of absence of applicant as well as his counsel, therefore, no Bineet Kumar Yadav @ Vineet Kumar Yadav vs State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Home ...

entities.text: Bineet Kumar Yadav @ Vineet Kumar Yadav vs State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Home
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: interference by this Court is warranted.

Having heard learned counsel for the applicant, learned A.G.A. for the State and upon perusal of the record, this Court does not find any reason to interfere with the impugned order dated 01.04.2023 which has been rightly passed in the facts of this Court.

However, to enable the applicant to appear before the learned trial court in order to get the charge framed, it is provided that in case, the applicant appears on the date so fixed as undertaken by learned counsel for the applicant, the process issued against the applicant shall not be given effect to till 29.04.2023 only.

It is also provided that in case, applicant does not appear to get the charge framed on the date so fixed, the protection given herein above shall automatically come to an end without any further reference to this Court.
With the aforesaid observations, the instant application is disposed of.
